newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: UFO expert says well-meaning aliens on the way. [CORRECTED 14:50 GMT]
newsitem.headline: UFO expert says well-meaning aliens on the way. [CORRECTED 14:50 GMT]

text.p: Erich von Daeniken (corrects spelling), known for his claims that space aliens visited earth thousands of years ago, said giant UFOs like those in the Hollywood blockbuster movie "Independence Day" would appear in reality in the next decade.
The Swiss author, who argues that ancient monuments were built by outerspace visitors, said the aliens would likely come in peace, unlike their movie counterparts who attack mankind.

"But they could also be agressive if they are locked in interstellar competition and need our resources," von Daeniken told the Swiss tabloid Blick. "Humanoid beings will come in the next ten years. They are observing us now," he said.
Von Daeniken said the aliens were assessing the risks they would face from human weapons and diseases and would then contact "state leaders, world religions or the United Nations".
"Independence Day", which has set box office records in the United States, tells the tale of invading aliens defeated by a world coalition of nations led by the United States.
